tests.title: cpu.fault (0075, way (a)): an undefined instruction at a chosen emulated time, thread mode, a chosen handler, UsageFault

cpu.fault condition faultmask 1: held back while FAULTMASK is 0 (FH), refused with mode thread and with faultmask 0; cpu.fault in a handler with FAULTMASK set (a fault the core cannot take): the stub of UDF and a branch-to-self keeps the core in it or a fault vector, state lockup or entered, FAULTMASK, BASEPRI, PRIMASK and the priority recorded, the image back after a watchdog reset

note: The image is firmware-tests/bench/net_test.c: its HardFault and UsageFault handlers keep the frame and reset by SYSRESETREQ (FF reads it). The stacked PC names the emulator's stub, not the image's code.
